# Native run: stopTest batch boundary

Captured 2026-11-13 using an `@IsTest` route at API 62.0, 67.0,
and 68.0. Each API used a fresh 30-day scratch org, subsequently deleted
and verified gone. The capture recorded execution order through Account
markers and an assertion after `Test.stopTest`. The nine observations are in
`org.tsv`; the available capture record gives the date, not a time of day.
